name: AdpSplit
definition: An error-driven adaptive split operator that replaces fixed-cardinality random child placement with view-loss-aware child generation to determine the number of split children and initialize their parameters from L1-pixel-error region statistics.
summary: AdpSplit is an error-driven adaptive split operator for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces fixed binary splits with view-loss-aware child generation based on L1-pixel-error statistics.
